title: Intelligent AI Assistant
highlights: Automates 10+ daily tasks, 60% less manual effort
shortDesc: Autonomous assistant using LLM function calling to automate 10+ daily tasks.
fullDesc: An autonomous digital assistant orchestrated with complex LLM function calling that automates daily workflows — email synthesis, calendar management, and system-level control. Re-architected synchronous prompt chains into parallel async retrieval pipelines for faster responses, and integrated Google Vision API for multi-modal input.
